Latin word

ūtilis

ūtilis, ūtile

adjective, third declension; with the dative or ad · Declension on Wiktionary

useful, of use, good for

In this lexicon

  • useful

    the recommended word · classical · Phaedr. 4.13.1: ūtilius hominī nihil est quam rēctē loquī; Mart. 14.144.1–2: tergendīs spongia mēnsīs ūtilis

  • ad discendum ūtilis: educational

    * our formation

Examples

  • sum cocleīs habilis, sed nec minus ūtilis ōvīs. numquid scīs, potius cūr cocleāre vocer?

    I am handy for snails, but no less useful for eggs. Do you know why I am called after the snail rather than the egg?Mart. 14.121

    In the entry for useful

  • nisi ūtile est quod facimus, stulta est glōria

    unless what we do is useful, the glory is foolishPhaedr. 3.17.12

    In the entry for useful

  • Hoc tibi ūsuī erit.

    This will come in handy for you.composed
